english: The angel stands tall. She's blocking the hallway, leading further into the Coinlord's mansion.
She looks like a giant in here, despite the high ceiling.
Her many eyes glare at you.
He will see you now, Cleric.
The words cause you to shiver.
The goblin gives you a stern look.
Your muscles scream for you to be ready for a battle.
Yeah. This is dangerous. Super dangerous.
A battle of wits. This'll go great.
Be finished with your business here.
The Magistrate will not have time again, Cleric.
The spinning eyes stop for a moment.
Do I get the tower all to myself?
I'm not taking your bed, am I?
I'll be going to the Guard Tower then.
She is silent for a beat.
She doesn't mean you're roommates exactly.
You realize she does not breathe. Such interesting biology.
Ah. So that's why... (Gesture towards her face.)
She bows her head slowly, but does not respond.
There is a bedroll on the upper floor.
Her words are fair. Yet she does not have the right to order you around.
